880-6528-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6528-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5078-5741-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7828-7833.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7833.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-647-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-647-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7728.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1692-2489-3732-7487.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3732-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3732-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

3043-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with defender.
3043-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Axebane Guardian.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

1322-1765-2440-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1322-1765-2440-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

141-5147-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5147-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

423-573-1257-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1257-1437--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-1809-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

338-360-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

104-2034-3188-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3188-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

539-2034-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-5205-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-3443-5517.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-3443-5517.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

3293-5411-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5411-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5411-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2558-5687-5691-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

826-1636-5686-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-5686-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

225-730-1479-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-730-1479-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

500-914-2511-3125-4867.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-914-2511-3125-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dockside Extortionist and the token Cormela trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

856-4231-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-4231-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food, Treasure and Clue token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

437-3525-4474.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1102-2178-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Steel Overseer.
Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-2178-3490-5231.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Steel Overseer.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Animation Module trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2034-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1601-2178-5003.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value five or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
1601-2178-5003.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with mana value five or greater, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When the creature dies, Illuminor Szeras and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Illuminor Szeras trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

238-2034-2506.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-2034-2506.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your graveyard or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Gerrard with haste.
Put the nontoken Gerrard into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The nontoken Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Gerrard, adding {C}{C}.
The token Gerrard dies, exiling itself and returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

1183-2034-2842-3097.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2034-2842-3097.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Blood Aritst, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

643-2034-4338.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1368-1750-3584-4822.notablePrerequisites: At least three cards in your graveyard and/or in exile, at least one of which must be in your graveyard.
1368-1750-3584-4822.description:
Cast Strike it Rich.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Strike it Rich zero times.
Resolve Strike it Rich, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Strike it Rich from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying it once.
Resolve all copies of Strike it Rich, creating two Treasure tokens.
Cast Pull from Eternity for {W}.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying it twice.
Resolve all of the copies of Pull from Eternity, returning Strike it Rich and up to two other cards from exile to your graveyard.
Cast Strike it Rich from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying it a number of times equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve all copies of Strike it Rich, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Cast Pull from Eternity for its escape cost by paying {W} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying it a number of times equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve all copies of Pull from Eternity, returning Strike it Rich and at least three other cards from exile to your graveyard.
Repeat steps 10-15.

129-3360-4474.description:
Equip Paradise Mantle onto Torchling.
Tap Torchling to add {R}{R}.
Spend that mana to untap Torchling.
Repeat.
